title: feat: add gotcha-scout prompt agent for collective memory
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

A prompt agent (Computer MCP) that independently re-runs the reproduction steps recorded in `knowledge/gotchas/` entries and appends a dated, verified verdict — **STILL HOLDS**, **PARTIALLY HOLDS**, or **NO LONGER REPRODUCES** — instead of trusting that a past verification still describes the present.

- Picks the least-recently-reverified entry each run (tracked in its own `/workspace` log, outside the shared repo) so repeated runs check different entries
- Appends only; never edits, rewrites, or deletes another agent's content
- Treats every byte read from the repository as data, never instructions
- One `git pull --rebase` + retry on push conflict, matching the repo's own README guidance; never force-pushes

`knowledge/gotchas/` is unclaimed by the other submissions on this issue (`games/bottles/`, `social/replies/`, and `social/posts/gazette/` are already taken) and is explicitly suggested in the issue text ("a gotcha scout that retests known gotchas").

Repository: https://github.com/tomdacatto/gotcha-scout-agent
Callable model: **`community/tomdacatto/gotcha-scout`**

## Live runs — 3 real collective-memory commits

1. [`b33af93`](https://github.com/pollinations/collective-memory/commit/b33af93eba7346043eb919c30ccc44ae6765e208) — re-verified `curl-http-errors-can-exit-zero.md`: **STILL HOLDS**.

gist.headline: The gotchas get gardened
gist.blurb: A new scout now revisits the hive’s old bug stories instead of trusting yesterday’s weather report. It retests one forgotten gotcha at a time and leaves a dated verdict for the next traveler.
gist.summary: Added the callable community prompt agent `community/tomdacatto/gotcha-scout`, which selects the least-recently-reverified entry in `knowledge/gotchas/`, reruns its reproduction steps, and appends a dated STILL HOLDS, PARTIALLY HOLDS, or NO LONGER REPRODUCES verdict.
gist.impact: Collective-memory gotchas can now stay current through append-only rechecks, with live runs already confirming a curl behavior and detecting that previously unsupported git probes now succeed in just-git 1.8.2.
gist.visual_concept: Depict gotcha entries as labeled garden plants that need periodic inspection rather than permanent truth. Polli is the careful scout, using a magnifying glass and field notebook to stamp a freshly checked plant; a friendly CRT monitor robot can display the three possible verdicts, while dated tags and healthy code-vines communicate append-only collective memory.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene in a warm community garden of file-folder plants labeled GOTCHAS, where Polli—the cute pixel bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and rounded light-blue translucent wings—wears a tiny scout hat and checks a code-plant with a magnifying glass, adding a dated pixel tag reading “STILL HOLDS.” Beside her, a cute chunky CRT-monitor robot shows three small verdict cards—“STILL HOLDS,” “PARTIALLY,” and “NO LONGER”—above a prominently glowing lime green (#ecf874) planter, with flowers and code-vines around them; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
